entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ashkhen Hovakimian, also known as Agnes Joaquim, was a Singaporean plant breeder who bred Singapore's first hybridised orchid hybrid, the Vanda Miss Joaquim. Joaquim was inducted into the Singapore Women's Hall of Fame in 2015.
